'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**The [[United Nations]] Middle East envoy says the conflict has killed over 200 [[Palestinian]]s and nearly 30 [[Israelis]] this year, surpassing the previous year. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-violence-killings-twostate-settlements-983aa4e1705d6f00ea708771e54e4edf (AP)]
**A [[Palestinian]] man opens fire on [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlers]] driving in [[Hebron]] in the occupied [[West Bank]], killing a woman and injuring a man. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/21/one-israeli-dead-one-wounded-in-shooting-near-hebron (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
***[[Ukraine]] claims that [[saboteurs]] coordinated by [[Main Directorate of Intelligence (Ukraine)|military intelligence]] destroyed a [[Tupolev Tu-22M]] [[heavy bomber]] at the [[Soltsy-2 (air base)|Soltsy-2]] airbase in [[Novgorod Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-moscow-drone-attack-6014e06e35df54240a91e09d9ef45628 (AP)]
***Two people are injured by falling debris from a Ukrainian [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drone]] strike on [[Moscow]] and flights are disrupted at the city's airports. [[Russia]] says they shot down one drone and [[Radio jamming|jammed]] another. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-destroys-ukrainian-drones-moscow-region-flights-disrupted-2023-08-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[Germany]]'s [[Deutsche Bundesbank|central bank]] announces the country's economy will be stagnant in the third [[fiscal year|quarter]], due to high [[Electricity pricing|energy prices]] and rising [[Financing cost|borrowing costs]]. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-economy-stagnation-third-quarter-add0583dd637a64e67adf8f94c847fb5 (AP)]
*[[Somalia]] orders its telecommunication companies to block [[1xBet]], [[Telegram (software)|Telegram]] and [[TikTok]], saying that [[militant group]]s like [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] use these apps to spread inappropriate content and [[misinformation]] to the public. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/21/somalia-bans-tiktok-and-telegram-over-horrific-content-misinformation (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**A [[tropical storm]] warning is issued for the southern coasts of the [[Dominican Republic]] and [[Haiti]] due to [[2023 Atlantic hurricane season#Tropical Storm Franklin|Tropical Storm Franklin]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/haiti-dominican-republic-warn-floods-landslides-tropical-storm-102424409 (ABC News)]
*[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
**[[Mayor of Maui County|Maui County Mayor]] [[Richard Bissen]] says that 850 people are still missing after the [[wildfire|wildfires]] in [[Lahaina]] and other areas of [[Maui]], [[Hawaii]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna100918 (NBC News)]
*[[Cyprus]] [[Cyprus Police|police]] rescue 18 [[Syrian]] migrants after their boat started taking on water off the island's southeastern coast. [https://apnews.com/article/migrants-cyprus-syria-boats-rescue-2fc8d490fb717c34287d6552e2d98be8 (AP)]
*[[Greece|Greek]] [[Hellenic Coast Guard|patrol boats]] rescue nearly 80 migrants in the eastern [[Aegean Sea]] who were trying to cross from [[Turkey]] in inflatable dinghies in two separate incidents. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-migration-boats-turkey-02a1f4d4bcb1f2e60c66bc0f921f4f13 (AP)]
*Twelve people are killed and 19 others are injured when a bus crashes into a roadside ditch in [[Yozgat]], [[Turkey]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bus-crash-turkey-bc3182049ce6f352dc322cbbc91e6064 (AP)]
*Eleven people are killed in an explosion at a coal mine in [[Yan'an]], [[Shanxi]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-coal-mine-explosion-a070d675ba0900ba909604346c60480a (AP)]
*One person is killed and two others are injured in a high-rise building explosion in [[Bishkek]], [[Kyrgyzstan]]. [https://m.akipress.com/news:726390:Korean_national_died_as_a_result_of_explosion_in_apartment_block_in_Bishkek,_2_injured/ (AKIPress)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in the United Kingdom]]
**[[Metropolitan Police|London police]] say they will take no further action in an investigation into allegations that associates of King [[Charles III]]'s [[The Prince's Foundation|charity]] offered to help a [[Saudi Arabia]]n [[billionaire]] secure a [[knighthood]] and [[United Kingdom|British]] [[citizenship]] in return for [[donations]] of up to £1.5 million. [https://apnews.com/article/king-charles-third-saudi-billionaire-a3f02e6adfa8b1158156d91d8388c6aa (AP)]
*[[Countess of Chester Hospital#Lucy Letby killings|Countess of Chester Hospital baby murders]]
**[[Lucy Letby]] is sentenced to a [[whole-life order]] following her conviction on seven counts of [[Murder in English law|murder]] and seven counts of [[attempted murder]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-66551231 (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 World Athletics Championships]]
**[[Sha'Carri Richardson]] wins gold in the [[2023 World Athletics Championships – Women's 100 metres|100 m]] at the [[2023 World Athletics Championships|2023 World Championships]] in Budapest, beating [[Shericka Jackson]] and [[Shelly-Ann Fraser-Pryce]] in a new [[List of World Athletics Championships records|championships record]] time of 10.65 seconds.
